_readme: Said only when the player is carrying the key. Chosen by games/quest/quest_hooks.gd,
not by anything in the dialog format - a node cannot be conditional, and deliberately
so: three lines of game code beat a mini-language every dialog file has to learn.

notice.speaker: Warden
notice.text: That is the key. You found it in an afternoon.

shrug.speaker: Warden
shrug.text: Go on, then. The gate is that way, and it has been that way a long time.
